本评论来自分诊座位(R+81 集中轮,裸卡 21/40)。⛔ 本座位不认领、不派发、不写码、不合并。

## 判据

**三处断言现场逐条复验通过**(读 `origin/main` = `fc9ba76a`):

| 锚点 | 原文 |
|---|---|
| `content/docs/protocol/backward-compatibility.mdx:20-21` | MINOR 行 Guarantee = *"Existing code continues to work"* |
| 同页 `:88-97` | Breaking Change 表 6 行全部映射 `MAJOR` |
| 同页 `:104` | *"Minimum 30-day community review period"* |
| 同页 `:107` | *"Breaking change ships in the next MAJOR version"* |
| 同页 `:61` / `:77` | Phase 3 = *"Removal (next MAJOR release)"* |
| 同页 `:177-199` | #13779 加的推翻段;`:199` 明写 *"this section is the operative rule wherever the two disagree"* |
| `content/docs/releases/index.mdx:50-51` | *"**Minor** releases add capabilities without breaking existing metadata or code."* |

机制侧一并复验:`.changeset/pre.json` 缺席 ⇒ `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` 处于**执行态**,本地跑回 `✓ This diff introduces no major bump.`。「不烧 MAJOR」不是惯例,是**门禁**。

## ⚠️ 两页不同质 —— 判据必须分开写,卡把更严重的一页排在了第二位

- **protocol 页是「有序假」**:两种说法并存,并带**显式优先级条款**(`:199`)。缺陷是**读者相遇的顺序** —— 假表在 `:20`,更正在 `:177`,相隔 157 行。
- **`releases/index.mdx` 是「无条件假」**:对该页 grep `launch window|Launch Window|lockstep` → **0 命中**,全页没有任何推翻条款。⇒ 这一页更重,应当先改。

## 「30 天社区评审」:从「顺手看看」升格为**范围内的第三条假承诺**

卡把它列为 *"Also unverified … worth a look in the same pass"*。独立复验(对 `.github/` `scripts/` `docs/` 全域 grep `30-day|30 day|thirty.day`):命中全部无关 —— 依赖新鲜度默认窗、PM 视窗计算、附件宽限期。**无任何机制**。

⛔ 但「无脚本」≠「无流程」。实施者二选一:**找到可指向的真实流程证据并在页上给出出处**,或**删除该承诺**。⛔ 不许原样留着——它是对客的量化保证,而且与实测发布节奏相抵(17.2.0 在 MINOR 里按 ADR-0049 退役了 `http_request_errors_total`)。

## 围栏判定(`content/docs/releases/`)

围栏原文自带出口:「file an issue or make it a **dedicated docs-only PR** — never a rider on code changes」。本卡纯文档 ⇒ **走专用 docs-only PR 合规**。

一个 PR 还是两个?实测两页 churn(全 1964 次提交内):`index.mdx` **3** 次、`v17.mdx` **5** 次。围栏的成因是 `releases/v<major>.mdx` 的**逐行追加冲突磁体**,`index.mdx` 不是那个文件。⇒ **两页合一个 docs-only PR** —— 两处陈述必须同时改才自洽。⛔ 该 PR 不得夹带任何代码。

## 路由

`pm:queue` · `priority:p2` · `domain:devx` · `documentation` —— 与父卡 #13779(`documentation` / p2 / `domain:devx`)对齐。锚点按**修复落点**取:版本号语义的机制在 `.changeset/` + `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`(发布流水线),`scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh:312` 明写「docs cards follow the surface they document」。

## 查重

`search_issues` 回 16 条,阳性对照 = 本卡自身命中 ⇒ 通道本会话可用。最近邻:#13779(已闭,父卡,明确划出范围)、#8411(changeset 的 breaking 标注,另一回事)、#12250 / #10232 / #8917(releases 目录的其他缺陷,均非版本语义)。⛔ 无重复。

## ✅ ACCEPT — [PR #14211](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/14211). Verified against the tree and the checks, not against the report

`domain:devx`, session `session_01WLJQhde67SeTccsmnBVarV`, R1. Reviewer of record.

**Checks — every one**: 33 check runs on `655c21fa3`, all completed, 0 red. **Path fork**: exactly 2 files via `get_files` (`content/docs/protocol/backward-compatibility.mdx` +27/−19, `content/docs/releases/index.mdx` +25/−5) — the triage-ruled dedicated docs-only PR, zero code riders, `releases/index.mdx` legal under the fence's own exit. No governed surface ⇒ ordinary ready → queue. Clause-②: no.

**All 8 anchors corrected, plus two identical-class lines caught in place** (:26 and :166 carried the same false mapping one bullet away from the corrected table — a bounded, declared, same-shape fix; leaving them would have re-stated the defect inside the PR removing it). The stability-phrasing lines were correctly NOT touched (different claim shape, governed by the hoisted callout).

**30-day claim: DELETED per the triage binary**, with the zero properly controlled (the grep is live — many unrelated hits — and `"review period"` occurs exactly once in the repo: the claim itself), corroborated by the 2026-06 docs-accuracy audit already listing it as unbacked. The `2-MINOR dwell` promise preserved VERBATIM and its unbacked-mechanism question filed as **#14210** (verified, open) rather than widened in.

**Fences held**: #14043's end-condition territory untouched (no date, no version, no criteria — only "tracked separately"); #13779's authority sentence kept, widened one clause because correcting the tables falsified its old first clause. Ablation on the load-bearing anchor link disk-proofed both directions.

**Disposition**: flipping ready, re-reading spawned checks, arming into the merge queue. Card stays `pm:dispatched` until MERGED. On merge, **#14043** re-prices against the rewritten pages before any dispatch (recorded on its serial note).
